title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.17789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. translated_title: 大语言模型能否优化预训练神经网络权重？——YOLO26目标检测中无梯度编辑的多阶段实证评估
translated_abstract: 直接权重编辑为微调预训练检测器提供了一种无需梯度的替代方案，但其泛化能力以及大语言模型（LLM）引导的价值仍不确定。我们使用YOLO26模型和MS COCO数据集评估了五个实验阶段，将确定性缩放、随机扰动、差分进化、CMA-ES、结构化干预、真实本地LLM提议、失败感知引导以及混合LLM-CMA-ES等方法与匹配的随机策略对照组进行比较。优化过程在1,000张COCO Val2017图像上使用Ultralytics原生的mAP50-95指标进行；选出的候选方案在一个不相交的、此前已检查过的1,500张图像子集上进行评估，并在可用的情况下单独报告COCO API的AP50-95指标。将CMA-ES预算从8次评估增加到250次评估，使开发集收益从+0.11个百分点提升至+0.28个百分点，而选择集上的变化仍为负值（-0.03至-0.12个百分点）；250次评估的结果仅使用了一个随机种子。混合LLM（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究通过对YOLO26检测器的五阶段实证评估发现，包括LLM引导和进化算法在内的无梯度直接权重编辑方法虽能在开发集上带来微小增益，但在独立验证子集上泛化失败，表明大语言模型引导权重优化的价值仍然有限。
en_tdlr: This multi-phase empirical evaluation of YOLO26 object detection finds that gradient-free direct weight editing approaches—including LLM-guided and evolutionary methods—yield only marginal development gains that fail to generalize on a held-out validation subset, suggesting the value of LLM guidance for weight optimization remains limited.
